description: We are a team of enthusiastic students participating in our first NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about technology, space exploration, innovation and problem-solving. We believe in teamwork, creativity and learning new things. We welcome people with interests in coding, software development, AI, research, design and data analysis. Together, we aim to develop an innovative solution and make our first hackathon experience meaningful!
summary:
AstroWell is a web-based platform developed by Team IGNITE to monitor and support astronauts' physical and mental well-being during space missions. Space missions can affect astronauts' health due to isolation, limited physical activity, changes in sleep patterns, and challenging living conditions.

Our project provides a centralized wellness dashboard that brings together physical activity tracking, sleep monitoring, mood check-ins, and mental wellness support. It also provides daily wellness suggestions and alerts for missed check-ins or unusual readings, helping astronauts stay aware of their overall well-being.

AstroWell aims to make health monitoring easier, more organized, and accessible through a single platform. It supports astronauts in maintaining a healthier routine and promotes better awareness of physical and mental health during long-duration space missions.
details:
AstroWell is a web-based astronaut health and wellness monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to monitor important aspects of well-being, including physical activity, sleep patterns, mood, and daily wellness check-ins.

The platform works by displaying wellness information in an organized dashboard. Users can view health-related data, track daily activities, complete mood check-ins, and receive wellness suggestions. It aims to make monitoring physical and mental well-being easier and more accessible.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
AstroWell helps astronauts become more aware of their physical and mental well-being. It encourages healthy routines, supports regular wellness monitoring, and aims to reduce the challenges associated with isolation, disrupted sleep, and limited physical activity during long-duration space missions.

Tools and Technologies Used:

  • HTML – To structure the website.
  • CSS – To design the interface and space-themed appearance.
  • JavaScript – To add functionality and interactivity.
  • Database – To store and organize project information.
  • GitHub – For code management and team collaboration.
  • AI-assisted development tools – To support the development process.

Creativity and Innovation:
The creative aspect of AstroWell is its combination of physical wellness tracking and mental wellness support in one platform. We designed a space-themed interface with a clean dashboard to make the experience engaging and easy to understand.

Factors Considered:
Our team considered the unique challenges astronauts face in space, including isolation, sleep disturbances, physical inactivity, mental stress, ease of use, accessibility, and the importance of regular wellness monitoring.

Through AstroWell, Team IGNITE aims to contribute an innovative digital solution that supports astronaut wellness and encourages healthier space missions.
dataRefs: AstroWell – Astronaut Health and Wellness Monitoring System  AstroWell is a web-based astronaut wellness monitoring system designed to support astronaut health during space missions. It focuses on monitoring physical health, sleep patterns, and mental well-being through a simple and user-friendly dashboard.  The project aims to help monitor astronaut wellness, identify possible health concerns, and provide useful insights that can support better health management during long-duration space missions.  AstroWell brings together frontend technologies, a Node.js backend, and a database to build a centralized astronaut wellness monitoring platform.  Technologies Used:  - Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript - Backend: Node.js and Express.js - Database: Python and SQLite  Future Scope: AstroWell can be enhanced with real-time health monitoring, AI-based wellness insights, personalized recommendations, and integration with wearable health devices.
